column3: {text_effect:4}Uhnn... Ohh...{end_wait}
You'll stay here. You're\nour hostages now.{end_wait}
Keep your mouth shut, or\nhe pays for it!{end_wait}
They just won't die,\nwill they? They're back!{end_wait}
Then we'll just have to\nbeat them down again!{end_wait}
We'll make you sorry\nyou were born! Get 'em!!{end_wait}
They...{pause_20_skippable} They got us...{end_wait}
For a second there, I\nthought we were dead.{end_wait}
We... we won.{end_wait}
I'll get the mayor.\nDon't let them move.{end_wait}
After all we went through\nto steal this much...{end_wait}
Stealing from the dead\nand the dying? That's a\nspecial kind of low.{end_wait}
Damn it! I told you we\nshould have left town\nafter the first night...{end_wait}
You didn't get away with\nit. Nobody does.{end_wait}
I see... So that is what\nhappened here...{end_wait}
These are the thieves,\nMayor...{end_wait}
What you did is vile.\nStealing, while we were\nburying our neighbors!?{end_wait}
You people left your\ndoors wide open!{page_break}You were practically\nbegging us to{em_dash}OUCH!{end_wait}
Sorry... I was hungry.\nI couldn't help myself...{end_wait}
What should we do with\nthem?{end_wait}
We'll lock them away for\na long, long time. Maybe\nforever.{end_wait}
Hey! Wake up!{end_wait}
Hey, you! {actor_name:1}, right?\nYou'll regret this!{end_wait}
Take them away!{end_wait}
Thank you for catching\nthem. Vault owes you a\ndebt it can't repay.{end_wait}
We needed this. Truly.{end_wait}
Let's see what they took.{end_wait}
The mayor's urn. They took\neven that.{end_wait}
Mayor... isn't that your\nfamily's urn?{end_wait}
My family's ashes are\nhome again. Thank you.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3} took back the\nShaman's Rod.{end_wait}
I will not forget this\ntown's kindness... or its\nfear. Go well.{end_wait}
We should go. Whatever's\ncoming won't wait.{end_wait}

I can sleep now that
the thieves are locked up.{page_break}I kept thinking they'd
come for my gem in the
dark.{end_wait}
Thank the gods they were\ncaught before they took\nour gem.{end_wait}
Everybody wants my rock!\nThey'd take it from me!{page_break}I can't let my guard\ndown for a second!{end_wait}
What if the rock is\nworthless? Maybe that's why\nthey left it alone.{end_wait}
Did those thieves come\nfrom Lunpa?{end_now}

Lunpa's master is
Dodonpa, grandson of old
Lunpa himself.{page_break}He's a cruel man. Jailing
his thieves means
trouble.{end_wait}

The Lunpans were noble
thieves under Lunpa's son,
Donpa.{page_break}Dodonpa made them what
they are. Cruel, and
hungry.{end_wait}

My father fears for those
prisoners from Lunpa.{page_break}You'll protect us if
Dodonpa's men come, won't
you?{end_wait}
Lunpa went rotten because\nDonpa spoiled his son,\nDodonpa.{end_wait}
Father looks so tired,\nworrying like that.{end_wait}
The thieves stashed the\nloot in the hotel's loft...{page_break}and in the cemetery.\nAmong the graves.{end_wait}
As I thought, nothing\nwas taken from our house.{end_wait}
I suppose nothing we own\nwas worth stealing.{page_break}I'm not sure whether\nto laugh or cry.{end_wait}
I wish I owned something\nworth stealing.{end_wait}
You were a great help,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Allow us to repay you,\nas we promised.{end_wait}
Received {argument_item_name:2}.{end_wait}
You're carrying too much,\n{actor_name:1}.{page_break}Come back when you've\nmade room.{end_wait}
Are you heading beyond\nthe Goma Range?{end_now}

Look for a cave in the
Goma Range, northeast
of here.{page_break}Beyond it lies Bilibin.
If you survive the cave.{end_wait}
There's no other way\nout of here right now.{end_wait}
You're the one who got\nour urn back, aren't you?{page_break}Thank you. Truly.{end_wait}
I heard you beat those\nthieves!{end_now}
I suppose you can't judge\npeople by their looks...{end_wait}
Really? My father said you\ncaught the thieves...{end_wait}
{actor_name:3} hears what\nanimals say. He learned\nmore than he wanted to.{end_wait}
The Goma cave is\ndangerous. Be careful.{end_wait}
I'm so relieved to have\nour family urn back,\nsafe and sound.{end_wait}
When I grow up, I want\nto be strong like you.\nStrong enough to survive.{end_wait}

...I wish I had wings
like a bird...{page_break}I want to be free...
to fly away from here,
from all of this.{end_wait}

Our stolen weapons turned
up in the cemetery,
rusted through.{page_break}We have to rework them
before anyone will buy.{end_wait}

They left my weapons in
the cemetery. What's that
supposed to mean?{page_break}Someone telling me
my steel belongs with
the dead?{end_wait}
If you're heading into the\nGoma cave, be ready.{end_wait}
It must be snowing in Imil,\nnorth of the Goma Range.{end_wait}
With the bridge out, it\nwill be a long time\nbefore anyone sees Kalay.{end_wait}
Why is everyone so\neager to leave?{end_wait}
I'm shaken. Those guests\nof ours were thieves.{end_wait}
They hid all that in our\nloft, under our own roof?{page_break}At least they're caught.\nThe town can breathe again.{end_wait}
I have bones left from\ndinner. Nothing else to\nspare. Want some?{end_now}
Really? Take what you\nwant.{end_wait}
I don't blame you. Nobody\nlives on bones alone.{end_wait}

Who could have known they
were thieves?{page_break}Well... they paid well.
I won't pretend
I'm sorry.{end_wait}
Of course I suspected\nthey were up to no good.\nI just kept quiet.{end_wait}

I get so hungry when
I cook... There isn't
enough to go around.{page_break}It wouldn't hurt to
taste just a little,
would it?{end_wait}
You carry so much. Do you\nneed it, or are you just\nafraid?{end_wait}
What? You want more\nbones?{end_now}
Go ahead... Take what\nyou need.{end_wait}
I don't blame you.{page_break}Only a dog would be\nhappy with nothing but\nbones.{end_wait}
My husband says the cat\nate the treasure. I don't\nbelieve him anymore.{end_wait}
He really likes bones.\nHmm... I wonder what he's\nbeen eating before this.{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"History of Vault, Vol 1"{page_break}The book says Vault was
named for what it was:
a place to hide.{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Gems of Angara."{page_break}It says nothing about
the rock on the table.
Maybe it's better so.{end_wait}
